name: Selenium-substituted tantalum disulfide
equilibrium_context: Mott insulator for x = 0 and 0.5, superconductor for x = 1.0; commensurate CDW in the ground state

driven_states.emergent_property: Hidden CDW domain structure with a spatial anomaly (displaced domains) or an orientational anomaly (rotated domains), stacked star-shaped polaron clusters, estimated photodoping of about one ninth per cluster, accompanied by an insulator-metal transition.
driven_states.source: Sun et al., Sci. Adv. 4, eaas9660 (2018), doi:10.1126/sciadv.aas9660
driven_states.caveat: Direct real-space imaging of the hidden domains, therefore more than phenomenology. The assignment of a photodoping of one ninth is, however, model-dependent. The stacking direction is not captured by plan-view transmission electron microscopy; consistency with the stacking collapse finding has not been checked explicitly.
driven_states.measured_quantity: in-situ transmission electron microscopy of the domain structure

sources: Sun et al., Sci. Adv. 4, eaas9660 (2018), doi:10.1126/sciadv.aas9660
